posts.title: Welcome to your nonprofit site
posts.excerpt: Nonprofit Starter is ready. Share your mission and replace sample stories.
posts.content:
The Nonprofit Starter flagship gives you a public home for mission, programs, and stories.

Update Site Settings with your legal name, then rewrite these posts so supporters see real impact—not placeholders.

posts.title: How last month’s food drive helped 120 families
posts.excerpt: Sample impact story with a clear outcome number.
posts.content:
Sample story. Lead with the outcome, then explain how volunteers and donors made it possible.

Invite readers to the next event or a donation page when you have one.

posts.title: Volunteer orientation every second Saturday
posts.excerpt: Sample program post for recurring volunteer onboarding.
posts.content:
Explain who can join, what to expect, and how to sign up.

Include time, location, and a contact email so people can take the next step without calling the office.

posts.title: Three ways to support this month
posts.excerpt: Donate, volunteer, or share — a simple call-to-action post.
posts.content:
1. Donate — one-time or monthly
  2. Volunteer — shifts posted on this site
  3. Share — forward our stories to friends

Replace links and amounts with your real campaigns.
